checkpoint.purpose: Frozen fixed-pair SKU gate runs: v1 (frozen before labels) and v2 (label-informed development iteration); inputs, freeze, predictions for A/B x source configs, and post-freeze evaluation
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: inputs/, freeze.json and predictions/ contain no labels. evaluation/summary.json holds aggregate metrics plus per-case gold decisions and rationales for the 37 gold-review rows; evaluation/disagreements.jsonl holds gold decisions/rows/rationales for prediction-vs-label disagreements. labels.jsonl itself is not included.
